responsibilities.runtimeRoot: temporary task state, caches, logs and reproducible local runtime artifacts
responsibilities.taskArtifactsRoot: sanitized task evidence and machine-readable assessment records
responsibilities.canonicalEvidenceRoot: stable ignored evidence packages intended for project handoff
responsibilities.legacyWorkLabRoot: input-only historical reference; not a write target

secondaryRuntimeRoots.role: hook-escape runtime landing: pycache/uv/node-compile caches that the hermes-project-data wrapper routes outside .project-local
secondaryRuntimeRoots.note: not a canonical write target; declared here so boundary declaration matches reality. Slimmable on demand; never a task artifact.

secondaryRuntimeRoots.role: hook-escape task artifacts (3 files observed, <1MB); prefer .project-local/artifacts for new evidence

spillGovernance.rule: Every project artifact stays inside the project Git root; any write outside it is a spill and must be traceable, locatable, cleanable and migratable.

protectedDataVolume.policy: forbidden without explicit per-path, per-operation user authorization

spillGovernance.trace: every spill records source, timestamp, and exact target path
spillGovernance.locate: the exact spilled path is machine-resolvable for cleanup or migration
spillGovernance.clean: spilled artifacts are removable or revertible without touching project source
spillGovernance.migrate: spilled artifacts are relocatable back inside the project boundary

ledger.rule: One JSONL line per write performed by this project. outOfRoot=false lines record in-root artifact moves and cleanup manifests, so a cleanup is reconstructible from the ledger alone; outOfRoot=true lines additionally require target to be an absolute path outside the Git root plus a reversibility statement. A spill with no ledger line is an unrecorded side effect, not a spill.
ledger.note: The ledger lives under .project-local because it contains machine-local absolute paths; the DECLARATION is tracked so CI can enforce that a spill must be written down, without shipping this machine's paths.

artifactFlowSemantics.note: Clarifies the broad 'inside project Git root / no prompt-response bodies' phrasing. Business artifacts the user selected may flow to authorized material spaces; private session libs / telemetry bodies / credentials NEVER auto-mirror.
artifactFlowSemantics.projectPrefScoping: project/task-scoped preferences do not leak to other projects; global is a separate explicit authorization

readOnlyInboundRoots.declaredBy: owner handover 2026-10-06/07 plus the 2026-10-07 full-scope authorization
readOnlyInboundRoots.rule: Inbound owner material, not a project directory: read only, never written, never deleted, never copied wholesale. ~15 GB of multi-project material, so reads go through the central directory and a size filter rather than a recursive walk. Recovery INTO the repository requires the explicit opt-in flag, an artifact-flow ALLOW decision, a secret scan, and a stated digest pin when the source is an archive member.
